thread:
James (AE): OrionNet uploaded a CAIQ v4 + they ticked BYOK and SOC2 evidence. Link: https://drive.redwood/secforms/ ORION-CAIQ.pdf. Need triage + owner. ETA requested by EOD Thu.
Rachel (PS&S): I'll take the questionnaire. Quick: do they want our SOC2 or just control narratives?
James (AE): They asked for SOC2 evidence too. Pilot is 2 weeks starting 4/10. Also asked for committed capacity discount—need pricing input.
Mike (InfoSec): BYOK + on-prem asks mean we require a key custody diagram, KMS/HSM details, and rotation policy. Please ask them for specifics.
Anna (Sales Ops): For short pilots we normally offer credits, not discounts. If they sign within 30d we can apply credit. Tagging for pricing.
Rachel (PS&S): I'll draft answers. Can someone move the CAIQ to secure storage? Prefer not to leave on Drive.
questionnaire-bot: moved ORION-CAIQ.pdf to s3://redwood-secure/questionnaires/1743210123/ with access logging.
James (AE): Plan: Rachel owns questionnaire responses, Mike owns KMS/architecture signoff, Anna handles pricing guidance, I'll request missing artifacts from Orion.
Mike (InfoSec): James, please request these items: key custody diagram, KMS type (HSM/KMS), rotation policy. Optional: vendor HSM attestation.
Rachel (PS&S): ETA for draft answers: Tue EOD. Who reviews SOC2 evidence if they send it?
Anna (Sales Ops): Security reviews evidence; if Orion asks for our SOC2 we route via Legal and the secure vault.
James (AE): Rachel, mark fields needing evidence and I'll collect them from the customer.
Rachel (PS&S): Will flag evidence fields and any partial answers.
Mike (InfoSec): Note for on-prem: network peering, restricted egress, audit log export, SLA adjustments. See internal on-prem checklist.
Mike (InfoSec): https://docs.redwood/internal/onprem-checklist — reviewers: @Rachel @Anna
Rachel (PS&S): One blocker: they require E2E encryption at rest with customer-managed keys. We support BYOK; I'll draft CAIQ language for that requirement.
Anna (Sales Ops): Pricing note: Dedicated or Private setups change the quote materially. Hold final pricing until security confirms deployment model.
James (AE): Agreed. Next steps: Rachel draft by Tue EOD, Mike KMS signoff by Wed, James to follow up on pricing. @Lena looped for SOC2 handling.
Lena (Legal): I'll handle SOC2 sharing process; we'll provide a redacted report through the secure vault on request.
Rachel (PS&S): Uploaded answers draft to s3://redwood-secure/questionnaires/1743210123/answers-v1.md — requesting @Mike review.
Mike (InfoSec): Reviewing now. Added comment about token storage encryption detail missing.
James (AE): Customer call scheduled Thu 10am PT. I'll include expected decision date in the invite.
questionnaire-bot: reminder: idle threads >24h will escalate to security-queue.
Rachel (PS&S): Bumping—draft ready for final review. @Mike @Lena please sign off.
Mike (InfoSec): Final signoff given pending receipt of key flow diagram from customer. No other blockers for pilot.
James (AE): Customer confirmed they'll deliver key diagram by Tue 5pm PST. Status: in-progress. End of thread.
